measures.name: Renderer
measures.definition: Every voiced cue's onset, the first sample that is not zero of the cue rendered alone before the master (where its voice starts, whatever sounds with it), against its cue time (an unplaced background against the first sample bedSpan gives it, half the crossfade early); each voice group's stem against the sum of its cues rendered alone, so each onset read alone is where the stem plays it and no voice leaks into another or sounds where no cue is; and no detection on the stem (preciseOnsets, the group's gap) outside every cue span of its group. A renderer test, not sync. The onsets are not the detector's: on a tail that is still sounding it fires again every minGap
measures.bar: Within 0.005 s; each stem the sum of its cues alone within 0.000001 (starting value) of its peak
measures.source: ROADMAP Sound 2.6 and SOUND-PLAN 4.5: the renderer, onsets against cue times, every voiced cue (the S8.2 layers reached it); the sum: tests/sound-blockout.test.mjs: the stems against the mix measured one float32 step (1.3e-7 of the peak); about eight steps
measures.summary: 142 voiced cues (93 one-shots), 142 within 5 ms of their start (worst 0.031 ms); 30 of 30 group stems the sum of their cues alone (worst 8.17e-8 of the peak); 0 onsets outside their group's cues

measures.name: Sync with the picture
measures.definition: Each sync cue's measured onset (the first sample of the cue rendered alone, the renderer measure's) against the first frame that shows its event, the picture's own state functions sampled at frame times (scripts/sound-report.js syncRule, sound-checks showingFrame); cueOk is check 4's verdict on the cue time. Modifiers have no voice and are not listed
measures.bar: Onset 0 to 0.045 s ahead of that frame (starting value), past its named lead; audio after the frame fails, except an instant on its frame's own time read within the reading's lag (1.5 samples) after it, which is on its frame (the lead's ruling, round 05)
measures.source: ITU-R BT.1359 via SOUND-PLAN 3.3 and check 4 (secondary)
measures.summary: 119 judged, 12 off their frame (0 judged otherwise than on their cue times); 8 have their instant on the frame's own time and read 0.02 ms after it, within the reading's lag, so on their frame; 17 not judged (no event the picture shows)

measures.name: Cue ends
measures.definition: Where each cue's own voice stops sounding, in its voice group's stem or alone (read): just after its last sample within 60 dB of its loudest (end), and just after its last sample that is not zero (last, the spatializer's ring), against its t1
measures.source: the decay RT60 measures: a voice has stopped 60 dB under its loudest sample
measures.summary: 142 voices; end minus t1 from -653.08 to 24.85 ms, median -4.42 ms

measures.name: Pan
measures.definition: Each voiced cue's balance (right over left, dB) over its span in its voice group's stem, against its placement's prediction (spatial.js placeAt under its law, weighted by the stem's energy each millisecond); an unplaced background against the centre
measures.source: SOUND-PLAN 4.5: today's car test; S8.2 measured 0.11 dB

measures.name: Level per cue
measures.definition: Each voiced cue's loudest 100 ms (both channels' power) on its stem before the master, against the street background measured the same way (overStreetDb), against the prediction (the level plan's level, its law at the camera and its modifiers at the window's middle: sound-report hear, which leaves out the air lowpass), and against the beds sounding in that window (overBedDb)
measures.bar: Reported, not gated: placeholders have no real spectrum (SOUND-PLAN 4.4)
measures.summary: 142 cues; measured minus predicted from -3.34 to 0.26 dB, median 0 dB; 62 of 136 non-background cues 6 dB or more over the beds in their loudest 100 ms

measures.name: Loudness over time
measures.definition: Momentary (400 ms) and short-term (3 s) loudness of the mastered blockout, K-weighted and ungated (EBU Tech 3341), every 100 ms: per shot the largest, median and smallest reading of the windows inside it, and the shot's own integrated loudness (gated)
measures.summary: the loudest momentary -15.29 LUFS in shot 5; short-term medians from -30.75 to -18.35 LUFS

measures.name: Silence windows
measures.definition: No measured onset of a hard-effect or foley voice group (every detection on its stem, and each continuous voice's first sample) inside a declared bed-only window (scripts/sound-report.js, SOUND-PLAN 3.11)

rows.window: the hush before the car (shots 1 to 2)
the final wide, held for music (shot 15)

measures.name: Voices
measures.definition: Check 12's count and allocator on the measured spans (each voiced cue from its measured onset to its measured end): a mono voice one, a stereo bed two; one voice per voice group, so two cues of a group sounding at once is a cut, except two backgrounds of a family inside the place change's crossfade (kind crossfade, intended)
measures.bar: At most 24 (psx-spx); zero steals, drops or cuts
measures.summary: peak 12 voices at 34.61 s (planned 12); 0 steals, 0 drops, 0 cuts; 2 crossfades of a background at the place change

measures.name: Density
measures.definition: Check 11 on the stems: every 10 ms, the voice groups whose energy over the trailing 100 ms is within 6 dB of the loudest group sounding, or with a measured onset in the last 100 ms, and the bodies they belong to
measures.bar: More than 2 bodies reported; more than 3 fails (starting values, Murch's two and a half)
measures.summary: peak 6 foreground streams (3 bodies); 15 runs over 2 bodies, 0 over 3

measures.name: Masking per band
measures.definition: Each voiced non-background cue's third-octave levels (IEC 61260 centres, Butterworth order 3) on its loudest 100 ms against everything else sounding then (the mix before the master minus its own voice group): the band where it stands out most and by how much, how many bands it leads by 3 dB or more, the broadband margin, the loudest other group (check 8's pairs), and check 9's predicted broadband margin. Per-band levels in measure.json bands
measures.bar: A cue with no band 3 dB over its masker reported (check 9's 3 dB, starting value); gated only at Sound 4 (SOUND-PLAN 4.4)
measures.summary: 136 cues; 25 with no third octave 3 dB over everything else in their loudest 100 ms (check 9 predicted 79 of the one-shots under 3 dB broadband)

measures.name: Phone and mono
measures.definition: Each voiced non-background cue's loudest 100 ms in the mono fold-down (L + R) / 2, its side (L - R) / 2, and on a phone speaker (the fold-down through a 500 Hz second-order high-pass, or 800 Hz for a small one, and an 8000 Hz low-pass; scripts/lib/audio-analysis.mjs PHONE_SPEAKER, with its sources), each as a change from the stereo level in dB, the phone level over the masker's on the phone, and the band it lives in (lo to hi, Hz). Check 14 run on those measured bands
measures.bar: Check 14: a story cue that lives only below 250 Hz or only in the side channel (side 3 (starting value) dB over mid) fails
measures.source: SOUND-PLAN 4.3 check 14; the phone model's sources are excerpts and a secondary text (audio-analysis.mjs)
measures.summary: 9 story cues, 2 flagged; on the phone the story cues change by -16 to -0.05 dB, in mono by -0.72 to 0 dB

measures.name: Determinism
measures.definition: The blockout rendered twice in one run, before the master's normalization: the sha256 of both channels' float32 samples

measures.name: Stems against the mix
measures.definition: The 30 voice groups rendered alone before the master, summed, against the whole blockout before the master: the largest difference in either channel over the mix's peak
measures.source: tests/sound-blockout.test.mjs: the stems against the mix measured one float32 step (1.3e-7 of the peak); about eight steps
measures.summary: worst 1.13e-7 of the peak at 30.4415 s

measures.name: Drift of the parked design layers
measures.definition: The design stage with the score parked (ambience, car, foley): each part that plays one-shots rendered alone, its onsets detected to the sample and matched one to one against the enabled one-shot cue times of the families it plays (within half their closest spacing, at most 0.5 s): each cue with its drift (onset minus cue time) or missing, the cues no part plays, and the extra onsets (every detection no cue claims: on a design sound still sounding the detector fires again every 80 ms, its gap, so extras 80 ms apart can be one sound, not separate events)
measures.bar: Reported, not a bar: drift is expected until Sound 4
measures.summary: 93 one-shots: 72 matched (drift 0 to 385.41 ms, median 8.69 ms), 18 missing, 3 with no part to play them; 102 extra onsets

measures.name: The blockout's loudness target
measures.definition: The raw blockout normalized to integrated targets from -16 LUFS down in 0.5 dB steps until nothing is limited: per target the limiter's largest loss in any 400 ms window (the raw RMS times the gain against the output's, on a 100 ms hop), where, how many windows lose more than 1 dB, the largest loss of one sample and where, the samples limited, the integrated loudness, the true peak (4x), and the momentary loudness of the street background (the beds alone, reverb in) and of the whole mix in the hush (the run-down's end to the end of the shot after it)
measures.bar: The loudest target at which no 400 ms window loses more than 1 (starting value) dB; the configured blockout target must be that one
measures.source: Sound 2.6: a click limited for a few ms is not a level change, a pumped idle is; 1 dB in any 400 ms window
measures.summary: chosen -23 LUFS (gain -0.169 dB, worst 400 ms 0.961 dB, worst sample 3.15 dB, true peak -2 dBTP, the street background in the hush -30.84 LUFS momentary); configured -23; every quieter target meets the rule too
